run_cosine_distances: run cosine similarity search on embedding files and save KNN results to HDF5
compute_pairwise_cosine: compute pairwise cosine distances across all embeddings in a directory of numpy files
find_knn_embeddings: find the K nearest neighbor embeddings by cosine similarity and save indices and values
load_sbert_embeddings: load sbert or LLM2Vec embeddings from numpy files with 2D shape handling
save_cosine_results_h5: save cosine similarity KNN indices and values to an HDF5 file with dataset sequence
